name: Asset Reference Research
purpose: Gather legally usable game-asset references and placeholders with complete licensing metadata: source sweeps, license matrices, placeholder-to-final mapping, and shippable attribution packs.
inputs: Asset brief with type, count, resolution or poly budgets, style anchors, and placeholder slots
Commercial status deciding whether non-commercial licenses are usable
Trusted source list plus blocked sources
Required attribution format for the shipping build
outputs: Licensed reference set mapped one-to-one onto briefed placeholder slots
Complete license matrix with author, source, license, and modification notes
Attribution pack with CREDITS.md entries plus vendor archives with hashes
stop_conditions: 100% of briefed needs mapped with 100% of shipped assets carrying license proof
Zero forbidden licenses present in commercial build paths
